If you are feeling overwhelmed or considering self-harm, please know that there are people who want to support you. You don't have to carry this alone.
In the United States, you can call or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline anytime, 24/7. It is free, confidential, and available in English and Spanish.
If you are outside the U.S., you can find a list of international helplines at findahelpline.com.
Conversing with a professional or a trusted person in your life can provide a safe space to navigate what you’re feeling. Things can get better, and reaching out is a brave first step.
